people.name: Magadan
people.line: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene

people.name: Mary_Magdalene
people.line: Follower of Jesus, first witness of His resurrection.

translations.web: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
translations.bsb: Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had driven out seven demons.
translations.kjv: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
translations.asv: Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
